question: A 72-year-old male visits his gastroenterologist for a check-up one year following resection of a 2-cm malignant lesion in his sigmoid colon. Serum levels of which of the following can be used in this patient to test for cancer recurrence?
analysis: In patients with colorectal cancer, carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) is a tumor marker commonly used to monitor for recurrence after treatment. Given that the patient had a malignant lesion in the sigmoid colon, measuring CEA levels would be appropriate for assessing potential cancer recurrence.
